questions.question: An isosceles right triangle has an area of 8 cm². The length of its hypotenuse is:
questions.explanation: Area = 1/2 * a^2 = 8 => a^2 = 16 => a = 4. Hypotenuse = sqrt(4^2 + 4^2) = sqrt(16 + 16) = sqrt(32) cm.
